[quote=dhornaper;61554389][B][u]The Communist Agitators[/u][/b]

[spoiler]Ever since the Majlis outlawed communism as an prohibited ideology, its adherents were forced underground. Student groups, formerly the main stronghold of communist ideology, were raided and had their members placed under lengthy investigations. The leaders of these groups were placed on the National Security Register, the nationwide database containing all citizens and foreigners involved in terrorism against Dhornaper and her allies, while lesser individuals were put on the police database as potential individuals of interest. While such harsh measures enforced so speedily were enough to shock the communists underground and prevent them from causing mischief in the short term, the communists were unlikely to abandon their sincerely held beliefs so easily.

Indeed, communists continued to meet in secret and discuss their ideologies through encrypted Internet communication platforms and anonymous Internet forums. The most vigilant and militant communists eventually ended up coordinating and forming a core of aggressive and hardened agitators. From this core came the most aggressive opposition to the government. Although most of their writings stayed obscure, one particularly fiery article made its way public and became widely shared:

[I]"The dictatorship of Fereydun Shah has proclaimed that communism is an ideology equal to the barbarism of fascism and its cousin, ethnonationalism. By putting it on such a level, the Shah has declared it an oppressor, a colonialist force, and a deadly idea that must be exterminated lest Dhornaper fall into the grips of tyranny.

With this, Fereydun Shah has imitated the imperialists he moves to accelerate the doom of. By his own greed for power and adulation, he is attempting to supress the worker's revolution so his power may remain strong. He perpetuates the supremacy of the bourgeoisie, as that is his power base, and subjects the proletariat masses to tyranny every day. His outlawing of communism is his fear of a worker's revolution. He knows it approaches and he is afraid of the spectre that haunts him. The dichotomy is stark for the proletariat: exploitation under the parvenu Shah and his bourgeoisie power base or liberation under a proletariat revolution. The revolution cannot be suppressed.

Fereydun Shah demonstrates the fundamental truth of liberal democracy. The opium it feeds to the workers, that their plight is temporary and will improve under a harmonious social contract with the bourgeoisie, is a myth. All liberal democracies will degenerate. Fereydun Shah has become a ruler far more absolute than anything Jalaludin Shah or Ayub Khan could have dreamt of. He condemns communism as a mortal threat to Dhornaper as it is a mortal threat to his absolutist reign. Only communism is capable of overthrowing the oppressive regime of the bourgeoisie and creating a truly equal society."[/i]

It spread like wildfire. Underground communist groups and "political clubs" began sharing it and soon it reached the wider public. At this point the pamphlet couldn't be contained and the government lifted the censorship on reporting but established certain key "facts" media outlets had to report along side it:

[List=1]
[*]The pamphlet bore inspiration from Socialist International and Stuipendian literature, banned in Dhornaper for calling for the overthrow of the government.
[*]The authors of the pamphlet were likely members of a proscribed communist group which had thrown molotov cocktails at police stations.
[*]The Ministry of Internal Affairs is investigating the proscribed groups and tracking down their underground members.
[/list]

The pamphlet forced the Ministry of Internal Affairs to reveal its hand quickly. Several servers hosted on the dark web, which had been hacked with help from the newly formed cyber defence centre, had already been using malicious code that exploited bugs in older browsers to gain access to user devices. While plenty of users were identified, the more vigilant users remained impervious and anonymous. Nevertheless, the Ministry of Internal Affairs' counter-terrorism teams raided homes in night raids and bagged dozens of communists while the regular police raided already known persons of interest. It was one of the most complex operations in Dhora policing history.

To further enhance the image of the police, all suspects were paraded in Shar as they made their way to the central prison with people and the media taking pictures and watching them pass by. Given the magnitude of the crimes they're accused of: treason, plotting terror attacks, and being part of proscribed groups or having proscribed literature, they would remain in custody until the courts deal with them. The Ministry of Internal Affairs had its image restored and buffed up after the embarrassing proliferation of incendiary literature.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=[b]On the Dhora Revolution[/b]][b]On the Dhora Revolution
[sub]by Pio Graci[/sub][/b]

We must never forget that the triumph of the revolution cannot always be a sure thing. The monopoly on violence is sometimes powerful, and under the might of monarcho-fascism it holds the power to paralyze the spirit of an entire nation and to denigrate a people's movement far beneath the layers of the earth.

In the past, agitators of the revolution conceptualized what is known as the "propaganda of the deed", a mobilizing violence to spur the entire proletariat into action, in which attacks are made on government facilities, and in which state figures are symbolically assassinated as a call to action to any who might witness it. 

However, the problem of the propaganda of the deed is that it invites worse state terror. While it is pleasing to think of a situation in which the death of one man can inspire millions to march against the canceral forces of an imperialist society, the reality of violence is that it begets violence, and the violence of the individual cannot be sustained against the overwhelming violence of monarcho-fascist repression. Individual acts of terror, therefore, constitute adventurism and left opportunism, for they diverge from the mass line and the protracted people's war by placing the fate of the people's revolution in the hands of lone wolves.

Those that desire the red banner must understand that it is both a violent force and a peaceful one.

There are two types of actions against the state that preclude any revolution, "agitation" which is direct and "propaganda" which is indirect. The propaganda of the deed, despite its name, is in fact agitation, and especially of the kind favored by anarchist lines. True propaganda is non-violent and never immediately apparent to the enemies of the revolution. In Cui Jin's [i]Propaganda[/i], it constitutes the various subliminal acts and creative pursuits, written or spoken, which are created to dull the influence of the bourgeois state. 

Equally important to violence is the ability to build things. Even in a scenario in which we succeed in destroying all evil overnight, evil will come back all the same if the masses have never been taught anything else.

We honor the courage of our Dhora comrades, but while they have named the enemy clearly, errors have been made in the prelude to a Dhora Revolution.

The pamphlet itself is not an error, rather its anonymity and distance from the masses. Propaganda must be traceable, not to individuals who can be arrested, but to movements that cannot be destroyed. An anonymous work, however brilliant, can be dismissed as the work of 'outside agitators' or 'terrorists.', as with now, in which Dhora government forces simply dismiss the pamphlet has having been written with inspiration from the Technate or from this International.

Consider what has happened since the pamphlet appeared. The government lifted censorship. This seems like victory, for the masses now access these very works, and yet nothing seems to have changed. The state only lifted censorship after ensuring they could frame the pamphlet's words. Every media outlet must now report that the work is a derivative of this International and that its authors commit blind acts of terror against the monarcho-fascist state. The message of the work is lost and has been turned against itself!

The revolution in Dhornaper will not come next month or next year. Fereydun Shah's regime is strong, his security services are capable, and his bourgeois base is loyal. The task of the cadres is not to accelerate the revolution but to survive until it becomes possible. In Dhornaper, the night raids have created martyrs and heroes. Government forces parade those that have been captured, their faces visible for all the public to see, and some indeed will find solidarity rather than fear in their bravery. 

To those that still breathe and seek liberty, do not use this opportunity to throw away your new soldiers, for martyrs and heroes are better served in the annals of a venerable history. It is only when you still walk the earth that you can aid in the emancipation of the masses! The state thinks it has crushed the revolution by crushing revolutionaries. It does not understand that the revolution is not in individuals but in the conditions that create these individuals. As long as workers are exploited, as long as the bourgeoisie rules, as long as Fereydun Shah sits on his throne, the conditions for revolution exist. The communists in prison today will be replaced by communists not yet born. The books that have been burned today will be rewritten from memory.

The fundamental truth of dialectical materialism is such that the base contradictions of imperialism deepen overtime. These contradictions will not disappear simply because the police are efficient, and so there shall come a day in which the suffering of the masses shall light the embers of the flame.

Until then, however, [i]attendre et espérer.[/i][/spoiler]

KV drones and Barracuda cruise missiles continue to be used in strikes on the islands and mainland. Almost a combined 400 per night are used to strike Rosenmarkket military bases, dry docks used for military repairs, ammunition depots on the islands and military fuel supplies as well as command centers. Continually, the SEAD presence would remain. If the SAMs lit up, only if for blinking the AARGM-ERs would be fired off. Tracking the last known location they continue onwards, using a radar at the terminal phase to search for the SAM regardless of whether or not they are blinking or turned on. To disrupt SAM operations MALD decoy drones are fired off to both spoof the targeting radar as well as pretend to be a legitimate target using DRFM. Additionally MWS Harpy fire and forget drones would be launched into the islands as well as the mainland. These loitering munitions would act largely the same as the Klinge 200 but would track radar emissions instead with the ability to loiter for days and then dive onto radars when they activate. 

The use of GPS and internet jamming would be ineffective against the Klinge 200 autonomous attack drones as the platforms are designed to work specifically in contested EW environments. Using a mixture of its onboard inertial navigation system as well as visual simultaneous location and mapping the drones are able to continue with their mission to strike the Rosenmarkket. Hundreds of meters up and relatively small they stay out of the effective range of most small arms used by the Rosenmarkket tactical lines until they detect their targets which allows them to dive on them at extreme speeds. While further drones would be deployed to maintain a constant deterrent to moving artillery pieces out of cave systems, the drones would also begin targeting military vehicles on the island as well as command centers. 

On May 12, 2028, the Republik would declare a blockade to all belligerent and neutral states on the Rosenmarkket islands in the White Strait. The blockade would closely follow a policy of non-discrimination with all neutral states being allowed to continue commerce as long as assistance is not provided to the enemy and neutrality is maintained. Additionally, a continued flow of humanitarian aid will be allowed. Under international law, the HDF and WDF reserve the right to stop and search all Rosenmarkket ships for contraband and the HDF would exercise this right on all Rosenmarkket ships seeking to enter the islands. To properly enforce the blockade Republik UUVs and USVs would place propulsion disablers within the waters surrounding the islands. M-73 small warhead torpedoes would be utilized to create non-lethal immobilizations of ships violating the blockade by striking the propulsion system. 

For the SCSID deployed reserve ships and other clearly marked ships on the White Strait, HDF KV drones as well as USVs and UUVs would continue their swarm tactics to deny enemy ships participating in military operations from accessing the islands. Against more heavily defended surface warships, LRASMs would continue to be used by JA-18s. Additionally, Elseyrjäger drones aided by intelligence from AU-11Js would begin using their hellfire missiles to strike smaller vessels carrying military equipment. False signatures would be quickly ignored by the verification system as AU-11J electro-optical cameras, SAR and RC-135s would quickly parse out real and false signatures. 

It would be extremely difficult for the Rosenmarkket Akira class submarines to detect the Donau-Klasse SSGNs located outside of the White Sea in open oceans. Their pump jet propulsion system, rubber acoustic tiles and machinery isolation would make passive listening extremely difficult. Within the White Sea, the long passive arrays of the frigates as well as Seahawks and massive amounts of sonobuoys would try to listen in to even the smallest sounds that the Akira could make. To address the issue of subs hiding near coastlines and on the bottom of the seafloor, saturated aperture sonar would be utilized. Synthesizing a much larger antenna the SAR would deliver an extremely clear picture by penetrating acoustic clutter near the seabed or coastlines. At coastal areas helicopters carrying magnetic anomaly detection would be used to search for large metal objects such as the Akiras, helping to add another method of detection. Should the subs be detected a response would be quickly executed. SMART missiles carrying torpedoes would quickly deploy kinetic solutions to the area for a strike. Also, UUVs in the area would be pulled in to swarm the submarines with Mk58 CRAW torpedoes. This would likely be an issue for subs bottomed onto the seabed as it would take time to refill the ballasts and get moving while a potential HDF response is arriving. 

Against the stealth aircraft the Republik would use a combined sensor profile to track them. First using low-frequency early warning radar systems on the ground, these would be used to find the general locations of stealth aircraft to then cue other systems. Using AESA radar from the combined CCAs and JA-35s, satellite systems and ground based radar the systems would work to build a comprehensive picture of the threat to then respond using the BVR air-to-air Meteor missile. Additionally, the HDF would utilize IRST to search for the heat signatures produced by the stealth aircraft engines and then follow up with a kinetic response. The majority of the shots by the Rosenmarkket F-35s would miss their marks with ALE-70 decoys protecting the JA-35s and BriteCloud DRFM disruptors sending most interceptors off course. However, a GJ-11 CCA would be downed over the White Sea. The attempt to force a closer fight with the JA-35s would be a mistake. With the fifth generation aircraft sitting far behind the MiGs and Sus would have to face the Vectis CCAs first. Commanded by the JA-35s the swarms of drones would engage the enemy before they would even come close to the HDF fifth generations, including with Meteor BVRAAMs and sidewinders should they come within range. Jamming and spoofing against the CCAs would be largely ineffective with the Bayesian analysis and multiple sensors of the CCAs and commanding JA-35s ignoring the false targets. 

ALBMs from the B1s would maintain a persistent threat for groups of aircraft landing to make repairs, refuel or rest no matter which runway they would utilize. Should the aircraft land, ALBMs would quickly follow up to strike them on the runway or hangar. Even if the SCSID wanted quick turn over for fuel that simply could not logistically be the case with maintenance (1 hour of F-35 flight = 5 hours of maintenance). The strategy for the Republik would be to push exhaustion. Under a comprehensive IADs, HDF pilots and aircraft would be able to receive rest, maintenance and refueling while the HDF strategy against Rosenmarkke would pursue the exhaustion of the Rosenmarkket air force in its ability to repair, rest and refuel if they were not destroyed in the air by CCAs and JA-35s. For this purpose on top of ALBMs, KV drones would be continually sent to destroy maintenance and refueling capabilities of the Rosenmarkket. 

Shortly following the retreat of hundreds Rosenmarkke howitzers into the cave systems the Republik strategy would come into action. Watching through saturated aperture radar and AU-11J drones  as hundreds of large armored howitzers retreated according to SCSID orders into the caves, the HDF would make sure to watch which entrances and exits were utilized by the defenders. The sheer mass of vehicles on top of the necessity of large enough entrances to allow large howitzers such as the Rosenmarkket Höser-AB in would allow Republik thermal, electro-optical cameras, SAR and surveillance drones to constantly track their movement into the caves. 

Based on the information gathered during this period the HDF would act quickly to capitalize. Elseyrjäger-10 large UAVs would push forward near the islands to begin delivering blows. Using thermobaric bombs the UAVs would use the enclosed space of the caves to their advantage by allowing the fine fuel aerosols to fill the space and then igniting it to destroy the equipment within. Additionally, the thermobarics would have the beneficial effect of working to cave in the entrances and seal the howitzers inside. Aforementioned satellites, AU-11Js and Elseyrjägers would maintain a constant surveillance over potential areas that the howitzers could attempt to exit to fire from. Should they exit from the caves, JASSM-ERs from JA-35s, bombs from Elseyrjägers and autonomous loitering munition drones would continually target them at the entrance. 

Although there are possibly exits where Republik surveillance was not yet able to locate the blunder would allow the geography to work towards the HDFs favor. If the Rosenmarkket stayed inside their howitzers would remain ineffective, should they leave their numbers and the constrained geography of underground cave systems would likely mean they wouldnt be able to leave en masse and quickly. Should surveillance notice exiting of the large howitzers, the aircraft and drones would quickly mark it down and respond with JASSMs and Elseyrjägers. Additionally, the locations of these exits and entrances observed by the HDF would be sent to the WDF along with constant updates on HDF surveillance. 

With most of the decoys being destroyed the HDF would continue its hunt for the remaining bunkers, although they now attempted to hide themselves better. Surveillance would be both multi-domain and track the logistical system around the bunkers themselves to determine targets. Using SAR and electro-optical satellites Republik analysts pore over ground disturbance, road access, unusual terrain and security perimeters. Additionally, thermal sensors are still able to search for heat. Human occupants, electronics, and machines continually produce heat allowing for exhaust vents, temperature differences and heat leaking through concrete to be identified. However, they wouldnt just look for the bunkers themselves but the vast system outside required to maintain it. AU-11Js and satellites would help the HDF search fiber optic cable systems, power line routes and satellite uplinks to find how SCSID and military command within the bunkers communicated with the outside world. Also, the HDF would track the logistical system behind the bunkers which would necessitate food, maintenance, and personnel movement using stealth drones and satellites. If the remaining bunkers are identified B-21 Raiders are further dispatched at night to drop GBU-57 massive ordinance penetrators as well as thermobarics into the sites.[/spoiler]
